items.claim: Scroll inside a shadow root never reaches the document's scroll listener, so the tile lags a frame
Scope membership walks the DOM tree while clipping walks the flattened tree, so a slotted tile drops out of scope
Paint containment on `<body>` cuts tiles to the viewport
items.note: f61853f6be's restructure already handled a paint-contained body. This commit also stops the body's overflow going to the viewport when the root or the body contains its paint, and reads the root's own padding box from its rect.

items.claim: A container resize that moves no tile delivers no frame, so buffers stay at the old size
A tile scrolled off a page where root and body clip nothing keeps its full `visible` rect
items.note: The viewport cut is skipped where the root has no client size (jsdom, or a frame with no layout).

items.claim: `overflow: clip` and paint containment ignore `overflow-clip-margin`
items.note: It honors the margin's box and length; scroll containers still cut to the padding box.

items.claim: A `content-visibility: hidden` ancestor leaves a nonzero `visible` rect
`clipToAncestors` cut tiles to the scrolled root's box, or to the box of a body whose `overflow` went to the viewport
items.note: → wait, see list below for exact shas

items.claim: Root/body clip uses the scrolled root's box instead of the viewport
Ancestor whose `overflow` applies to no box (`display: contents`, inline) collapses the tile
Paint containment (`contain: paint`/`content`/`strict`, `content-visibility`) is ignored
`clipToAncestors` stops at a shadow root
items.note: The walk now follows slot and shadow host.

items.claim: `scopeHolds` uses `Node.contains`, which does not cross shadow boundaries
Document scroll listener outlives the surface without `containerRef(null)`
items.note: It also survives a StrictMode remount, and the same cleanup covers the density watch.

items.claim: `registerTile(id, null)` drops whichever element now holds the id
items.note: `registerTile` now returns a release bound to the element it placed, and overlay, lens and lent-top-buffer tiles release through it. This was my own call: it is recorded in `docs/unruled.md` and written as a `minor` changeset.

items.claim: Swapping the container for one at the same place neither retiles nor repaints
items.note: This covers `TiledSurface`, and `LabSurface` now checks each canvas's own size instead of one remembered size.

items.claim: Narrowing the scope to an element holding no tiles never clears the dropped tiles' pixels
`useTileInScope` isn't told when a tile registers or unregisters under a scope
A painter that throws drops later painters and the after-commit callbacks
items.note: Each one now runs isolated and logs with `console.error`, as the repo's emitters do.

items.claim: dpr is read from the global window, not the container's window
items.note: `watchDevicePixelRatio` in core takes an optional window (`api` changeset for `@weasel-js/core`).

items.claim: Shadow-root clip
items.note: duplicate of the A finding above, fixed in 86a347690b.

items.claim: A registered clear that throws stopped the later clears and every painter
A slotted tile was walked through its light-DOM parent, not its slot
